children.name: Mecynoecia pulchella
children.description: Colonies branches broken into a short length, with 12 - 14 autozooecial tubes arranged around branch axis. Tubes narrow, short, with circular to oval aperture. Apertures are very densely arranged, situated on short peristomes. Frontal walls short, slightly convex, smooth, sparsely perforated by small pseudopores. Gonozooecium lacking.
